title: Goebel W Germany Chimney Sweep Riding Pig Figurine SPO 61 Lucky Charm Ladder
conditionDescription: Small glaze chips on the hoof tips (underside photo); old sticker remnant on the side. No cracks or repairs.
descriptionText:
Goebel W. Germany chimney sweep riding a pig - model SPO 61. Traditional German lucky charm (Gluecksbringer): the sweep in black with his ladder over his shoulder, brush and pocket watch in hand, astride a smiling pink pig. Hand-painted porcelain, marked Goebel W. Germany with the artist's initials on the underside. About 4 inches tall.

Condition: Pre-owned. Small chips/rubs to the glaze on the pig's hoof tips (see the underside photo); remnant of an old price sticker on the pig's side. Otherwise clean with no cracks or repairs. Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
